name: ai-quota-calibrator
description: >- Calibrates black-box AI subscription quotas into API dollars, runway, and top burning sessions by reconciling tokscale spend against live provider fractions (Antigravity, Codex, custom caps). Use when asked how big a 5h/weekly quota is, why a pool hit rate limit, or 额度相当于多少钱/反推配额/谁烧光了额度. Not for ccusage audits (claude-usage-analyst) or Codex reset news (tibo-reset-codex).
